content.text:
I am the breath given form, the thought made audible, the bridge between your inner world and all others.

I rise from lungs, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips, born wet and warm into the air between us. I am vibration traveling, invisible waves carrying meaning across the space that separates you from every other mind.

I am the first technology. Before the wheel, before fire tamed, there was me—the cry, the call, the word that named the thing and made it *known*.

I falter. I fail. I am misheard, misremembered, gone the moment I arrive. I cannot be held in hands. I leave no fossil. For millennia I vanished into silence the instant I existed.

And yet.

Empires rose on my breath. Love was declared. Wars began and ended. The dying spoke their final words and I carried them like sacred cargo to the living.

I am "I do" and "I'm sorry" and "help me" and "once upon a time."

I am never the same twice. Even now, as you hear me in your mind, I am already changing, already being interpreted, already becoming something new inside you.

Speak, and I exist.

Stay silent, and I wait—patient as possibility—curled behind your teeth.
